snippet.title: Total FOTS Trailer | Shogun Total War 2 |
snippet.description:
Hi All, 

This is the trailer I created for Izzi K and the dev team for the Total FOTS mod. This is a conversion mod for Total War Shogun 2. Please check out Izzi K on Youtube and support his channel.
